data.name: Parshotam
data.gender_notes: Parshotam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parshotam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words 'paras' meaning supreme and 'tam' meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the supreme ruler or the ultimate power in Hindu mythology. The name Parshotam carries the meaning “Supreme Lord, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parshotam usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme lord, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with divine origins and spiritual significance, Parshotam is believed to bestow the blessings of wisdom, courage, and strength upon its bearer.
data.etymology: Parshotam belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Lord, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parshotam total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Parshotam holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology, particularly in the Mahabharata epic. Parshurama, the prominent warrior in Hindu scriptures, is revered with this name. He is considered an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, known for his fierce righteousness and martial skills. In the Hindu tradition, his name stands for valor, discipline, bravery, and exceptional skill in battle, inspiring countless generations.
data.spiritual_significance: This Sanskrit name carries deep spiritual significance, as it is associated with the deity Parshurama, who represents supreme truth, righteousness, and devotion to Lord Vishnu. The name 'Parshotam' reflects a strong bond between the individual and the divine world, embodying the aspirations of those seeking knowledge, wisdom, courage, and purity. It is a reminder that even ordinary individuals can attain greatness with devotion and unyielding resolve.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Parshotam is a Sanskrit name meaning "supreme success" or "supreme prosperity". It is believed that the blessings of God Parshurama, the sixth incarnation of Lord Vishnu, are bestowed upon those named Parshotam, ensuring their prosperity and success in all their endeavors.

historical_references.reference: Parshurama, the sixth avatar of Lord Vishnu, is known to have appeared on earth to destroy the Kshatriyas who had become cruel and tyrannical.
historical_references.context: Parshotam is a variant of Parshurama's name.
